name: Free Cat
detailed_description:
Rich Skills:

More than 10 unique cat characters, each with special abilities.

Fast-paced, satisfying combat:

Block, perfect dodge, combos, executions, air combos, downward slashes, plus Boss moves coached by real-life fighters.

Diverse Exploration:

Chinese-themed puzzles offering knowledge, designed to avoid frustrating progress blocks.

Various levels: Sky, underground, sea, jungle, snow, underwater, with traps, puzzles, and jump challenges.

64 Achievements: Complete cat collection, exploration, skills, boss battles, hidden challenges, no-damage challenges, speedruns...

64 Collection Tasks: Hidden mice...

Special Soundtrack:

Boss moves and music work in sync.

Twist-filled, touching storyline:

A story about redemption and love, sacrifice, reunion, and friendship—explore the meaning of love in an adventurous journey.

Humorous and light-hearted:

Funny enemies with unexpected ways to defeat them.

Diverse Enemies:

Mutated creatures, evil hunters, spirits...

Hand-drawn Quality:

Detailed graphics utilizing GPU capabilities, interactive plants and animals.

A Story of Love:

Story-driven Adventure with Feline Allies
The tale begins with a cat-loving girl who tragically drowns saving a kitten from a sewer. On the night of her death, stray cats perform an ancient ritual - gifting her nine lives from their collective souls. Reborn with mysterious cat-linked powers, she embarks on an epic journey to protect nature and uncover the profound meaning of true love and harmony between humanity and nature.

Environmental Crusade
A shadowy organization is ravaging Earth: forests burn, oceans choke with pollution, and wildlife suffers. Partner with awakened cats and their animal allies to dismantle this ecological nightmare. Rescue endangered creatures, forge unbreakable bonds, and turn rescued animals into vital companions for your quest.

Supernatural Challenges
Battle mutated monsters born from environmental corruption. Confront vengeful spirits of tortured animals in haunting boss fights. Explore a world filled with mysterious mechanisms and hidden treasures, where every puzzle solved brings you closer to restoring Earth's balance.

A 2D Metroidvania Adventure with Feline-Powered Combat & Environmental Justice

Core Concept
In this hand-drawn Metroidvania, play as the reborn cat-girl hybrid wielding nine mystical lives. Traverse sprawling biomes with feline agility - wall-jump through poisoned forests, pounce across collapsing industrial complexes, and explore vertically layered urban ruins. Master fluid combat combining katana strikes with supernatural cat claws to purge eco-terrorists and their mutated beasts.

Soulbound Gameplay

  • Dynamic Duo System: Switch between girl/cat forms mid-combo. Chain air dashes with precision platforming to reach secret areas

  • Evolving Abilities: Absorb spirit energy to unlock claw-mark traversal (wall-running/ceiling hooks) and spectral vision for environmental puzzles

  • Ecosystem Revival: Each rescued animal grants permanent upgrades - owl glide, badger dig, otter hydro-dash

  • Nemesis System: Hunt 13 corporate executives-turned-monsters, each with phase-changing boss arenas requiring hybrid tactics

World Design
Non-linear exploration through 7 interconnected zones:

  • Drowned Cityscape (water physics platforming)

  • Burning Rainforest (fire-spreading combat mechanics)

  • Biohazard Labs (gravity-flipping puzzles)

  • Ghost Zoo (spectral platform challenges)
    ...each with unique environmental storytelling through animal spirit visions.

For Fans Of

  • The precision platforming of Celeste meets Hollow Knight's atmospheric exploration

  • Guacamelee! style combat/puzzle integration

  • Environmental narratives like Rain World

Key Selling Points
✓ 15+ hours of tightly designed Metroidvania progression
✓ 50+ animal rescue missions impacting ecosystem restoration
✓ Combo-driven combat with 100+ unlockable skills
✓ Dynamic soundtrack adapting to player's feline/human form

"Become Earth's guardian spirit in this redemption tale where every wall-scratch reveals secrets, every purr charges your spirit gauge, and every rescued pawprint makes the world blossom anew."

Girl and Cats. Nature Guardian. Forest Protector. Puzzle Adventure. Mysterious Exploration. Action Adventure. Metroidvania Style. Heartwarming Storyline. Impactful Combat. Action. Blocking. Infinite Aerial Combo. Aerial Combo. Aerial Slash Combo. Multiple Cat Characters. Rescue Animals. Hand-drawn Art. Breathtaking Visuals. Platformer
